problem: R5C learns synthetic structured sensor witnesses (paired event slots, two source roots, clock quality and physical timestamps). A valid independent challenge must measure evidence-based chronological inference without fabricating sensor input fields, known event identities or hidden labels.

fixed_model.checkpoint_policy: No retraining, no hyperparameter or selective-confidence adjustment using external corpus labels. Frozen code and interface.

candidate_public_external_corpora.author: Yuchen Zhang and Nianwen Xue et al., 2019, Temporal Dependency Tree
candidate_public_external_corpora.labels: Expert and crowdsourced textual event-time dependencies, e.g. before/after/overlap

candidate_public_external_corpora.author: Qiang Ning et al., EMNLP 2020
candidate_public_external_corpora.labels: Temporal ordering question answering about passages, not sensor witness chronology
candidate_public_external_corpora.hidden_test_answers: Author README says all test annotations have been removed. Leaderboard/custodian needed for gold.

qualification_method.checkout: GitHub Actions read-only checkout of two public external repos at immutable commit SHA
qualification_method.integrity: Recompute git-blob SHA-1 of each external annotation file and fail if unexpected
qualification_method.external_data_rules: No original articles or annotated question answers committed back to JANUS, only aggregate counts and source SHA256
qualification_method.source_checks: TDT nine-column tab-separated annotation integrity and relation counts; TORQUE passage/question schema, test gold absence
qualification_method.model_admission: Frozen R5C refuses any non-synthetic or unadapted external text; do not fill fields with predicted or expected labels.
qualification_method.output: JSON receipt with qualified sources and zero eligible model examples unless independently specified compatible witness adapter exists
qualification_method.forbidden: No backdoor conversion textual BEFORE/AFTER relations into independent physical sensor readings; no synthetic_only override; no unauthorized labels or time travel claims.

required_genuine_blind_experiment.independent_source_contract: Externally authenticated origin records with two evidence roots of verified independence, witness sensor clock calibration and capture vs arrival timestamp separation; no direct event ID or known target label in visible inputs
required_genuine_blind_experiment.external_custodian: Custodian prepares unseen cases, holds adjudication gold and release commitment; prevents authors from inspecting labels before frozen prediction submission
required_genuine_blind_experiment.precommit: Container digest, exact frozen weights and code hashes, inference cost budget, outcomes, abstention threshold and paired adjudication preregistered prior to gold release
required_genuine_blind_experiment.original_task: Chronological evidence-based inference, not textual QA relabeled as physical observation
required_genuine_blind_experiment.baselines: Frozen transparent R5B witness rule, single-clock weak baseline and always-abstain
primary_metrics: Paired selective-accuracy difference at equivalent safe coverage
Coverage with noninferior safety against strong rules
Independent family/root split and source checks
secondary_metrics: Paired uncertainty interval and sensitivity to shared-source dependence
required_genuine_blind_experiment.gold_reveal: Independent custodian scores immutable predictions only after receiving signed/no-edit prediction digest
required_genuine_blind_experiment.scientific_pass_condition: Requires actual externally hidden compatible witness records and demonstrated benefit over strong rules without extra unsupported claims; without data no pass/fail on generalization.
